description: NaTmO₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/amd space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TmO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent TmO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. There are four shorter (2.28 Å) and two longer (2.76 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Tm is bonded to six O atoms to form TmO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent TmO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent TmO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. There are two shorter (2.23 Å) and four longer (2.28 Å) Tm-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Tm atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Tm₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. There are two shorter (2.28 Å) and one longer (2.76 Å) O-Na bond length. In the second O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Tm atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Tm₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. In the third O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Tm atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Tm₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Tm atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Tm₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. There is one shorter (2.23 Å) and two longer (2.28 Å) O-Tm bond lengths.
